name: Tai Masaki
source: 25 years old and the son of the rich and famous painter, Tashiro Masaki. Tai’s real name is Tashiro Masaki Jr., but he prefers Tai. He’s also Nam’s boyfriend. Tai is a laid back and easy going guy. His vocabulary is below average and he tends to use a large amount of slang. Tai has no enemies and makes friends with everyone, and is especially fond of Ryo.
